**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. e.g.,
"I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Affected components**

- [ ] firmware (controller logic, pin map, entity names)
- [ ] analysis (wind, sun, post-bending, sim dashboard)
- [ ] tools (live control, debug utilities, calibration)
- [ ] docs (markdown, Jekyll site, build guides)
- [ ] hardware (schematic, PCB, panel presets)
- [ ] booth (Maker Faire materials, demo script)

**Will you work on it?**

- [ ] I'd like to submit a PR for this
- [ ] I'd like guidance from a maintainer first
- [ ] Just an idea, no plans to implement

**Additional context**

Anything else — sketches, references to similar projects, math.
